privacyText:
Naya Aasha collects only the information we genuinely need: the contact details you send us when you write, volunteer, or donate, and the programme records required to run our services and meet our reporting duties to the Social Welfare Council and other authorities.

We do not sell, rent, or trade personal data, and we do not share it with third parties for their own purposes. Information is shared outside Naya Aasha only where the person has consented, or where Nepali law requires it.

Sensitive information, including anything concerning a child, a health condition, or a person's protection needs, is stored securely and opened only by the small number of authorised staff whose work requires it. Programme and financial records are kept for the period our donors and Nepali law require, then securely destroyed.

You may ask us at any time what information we hold about you, request a correction, or withdraw consent for future use. Write to nayaaashanepal@gmail.com and we will respond within 15 days.

We handle personal information in line with the Individual Privacy Act 2075 (2018) of Nepal.
safeguardingTitle: Safeguarding children and adults at risk
safeguardingText:
The safety, dignity, and rights of children and adults at risk come before our programmes, our reputation, and our fundraising. This is not negotiable.

Everyone who works or volunteers with Naya Aasha, and every partner we work through, is bound by our code of conduct. All of them are screened before they begin and are required to report any concern. We maintain institutional child protection standards as required by Section 57 of the Act Relating to Children 2075 (2018).

We do not publish identifying stories, photographs, medical details, or personal histories without informed, freely given consent, and we never make assistance conditional on agreeing to be photographed or named. Children are asked for their own agreement alongside their parent or guardian, and consent can be withdrawn at any time.

If you have a concern about the conduct of anyone connected to Naya Aasha, or about a child or adult at risk in our programmes, please report it. You do not need proof and you do not need to be certain. Reporting a genuine concern in good faith will never be held against you.

How to report: email nayaaashanepal@gmail.com or call +977 9803095587. Reports go to our designated safeguarding focal point. We acknowledge every report within three working days, keep the identity of the person reporting confidential so far as the law allows, and act on every report, including those concerning our own staff, leadership, or board.

If a child is in immediate danger, do not wait for us. Call the Nepal Police on 100 or the national Child Helpline on 1098, both free and available 24 hours. The Women's Helpline is 1145. Where Nepali law requires an incident to be reported to the police or to the child welfare authority, we will report it.
